title: Chemical Mixing Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Chemical Mixing Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Preparation & Planning-Unknown hazards
-Incompatible chemicals
-Inadequate ventilation		-Chemical burns
-Toxic exposure
-Fire
-Explosion		20 (VERY HIGH)-Review SDS for all chemicals
-Identify incompatible chemicals
-Check ventilation system
-Verify emergency equipment available
-Eyewash/shower tested
2. PPE Selection-Incorrect PPE
-Damaged PPE
-Poor fit
-Contaminated PPE		-Chemical exposure
-Respiratory illness
-Skin contact		25 (VERY HIGH)-Select PPE per SDS
-Inspect PPE for damage
-Perform fit test for respirator
-Use chemical-resistant suit
-Double glove if needed
3. Chemical Handling-Spills
-Splashes
-Vapors
-Inhalation		-Chemical exposure
-Burns
-Respiratory illness		16 (HIGH)-Use secondary containment
-Pour slowly to avoid splashing
-Use funnels and pumps
-Work in fume hood if volatile
-Keep containers closed
4. Mixing Process-Exothermic reaction
-Gas release
-Pressure buildup		-Runaway reaction
-Fire
-Explosion
-Burst container		15 (HIGH)-Add chemicals in correct order
-Always add acid to water (not reverse)
-Mix slowly
-Monitor temperature
-Use cooling if needed
-Never leave unattended
5. Cleanup & Storage-Waste disposal issues
-Residue contamination
-Improper storage		-Environmental contamination
-Cross- contamination
-Chemical exposure		10 (MEDIUM)-Dispose according to regulations
-Decontaminate equipment
-Properly label all containers
-Store incompatible chemicals separately
-Secure storage area
-Update inventory
